record.paper_title: Conferences WORDS, years 1997-2017: Open Problems and Conjectures
record.original_question: Describe the structure of the Rauzy graphs of words reaching the mentioned supremum.

evidence.quote: Describe the structure of the Rauzy graphs of words reaching the mentioned supremum.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $u$ be a uniformly recurrent infinite word over a finite alphabet. For each integer $n\ge 0$, let $\mathcal L_n(u)$ denote the set of factors of $u$ of length $n$, and define the factor complexity $p(n)=\#\mathcal L_n(u)$ and the palindromic complexity $P(n)=\#\{w\in\mathcal L_n(u):w\text{ is a palindrome}\}$. Set $\Delta p(n)=p(n+1)-p(n)$. It is known that for every uniformly recurrent infinite word $u$ and every $n\ge 0$ one has
$$P(n)+P(n+1)\le \Delta p(n)+2.$$
The Rauzy graph $\Gamma_n(u)$ of order $n$ is the directed graph whose vertex set is $\mathcal L_n(u)$ and whose edge set is $\mathcal L_{n+1}(u)$, where an edge labelled $w\in\mathcal L_{n+1}(u)$ goes from the prefix of $w$ of length $n$ to the suffix of $w$ of length $n$.

Describe the structure of the Rauzy graphs $\Gamma_n(u)$ of those uniformly recurrent infinite words $u$ for which the above inequality is attained with equality (equivalently, for which the supremum $P(n)+P(n+1)=\Delta p(n)+2$ is reached).
artifact.status_search_result: The problem comes from a list of open problems posed at the WORDS conferences. Searches reveal active subsequent research on palindromic complexity and Rauzy graphs (e.g., on rich/closed-rich words and palindromic defect), but no source explicitly announces a complete structural description of the Rauzy graphs of uniformly recurrent words attaining equality in the bound $P(n)+P(n+1)\le \Delta p(n)+2$. The status thus appears to be unresolved in general.

status_evidence.title: Factor versus palindromic complexity of uniformly recurrent infinite words
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes the inequality P(n)+P(n+1) ≤ p(n+1)-p(n)+2 for uniformly recurrent words and discusses Rauzy graph structure.
status_evidence.claim: The bound is established but full structural classification of extremal Rauzy graphs is not given.

status_evidence.snippet: List of open problems from WORDS conferences including questions on palindromic complexity and Rauzy graphs.

status_evidence.title: On the Closed-Rich Constant of Infinite Words
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work continues to investigate palindromic richness and Rauzy graph structure.
status_evidence.claim: Research is ongoing but does not announce a resolution of the structural question.
